claims.claim: Researchers used an AI system to evaluate more than 100 million possible parameter combinations for printing GRCop-42, a high-performance copper alloy developed by NASA, and after only 40 physical experiments identified six viable settings including one at a record-low 500 watts.
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers used AI to search through more than 100 million possible settings for 3D-printing a high-performance NASA alloy. After only 40 experiments, the system identified six successful configurations, including one that worked at a record-low 500 watts.
